notes.title: Change and bugfix update 2023-01-11
notes.content:
Hi all, I just uploaded a small change and bugfix update.

Change:
[list]
[*] After clearing the level, the progress will not be reset automatically.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug that the achievement of "Black Stele" could not be completed.
[*]Fix some performance bugs.
[/list]
